description: UNTESTED on RTX 5060: the template resolve --profile picks per purpose and hardware profile (data/hardware.json). A purpose with no entry for the chosen profile, or whose entry names a template that no core or game layer has yet, falls back to the next lower profile and finally to the purpose's default_template (the API route). A game layer may add or replace entries in <authoring>/assetgen/template-profiles.json. Nothing here was generated or measured; the user tests the local branch on the RTX 5060 8 GB machine after the merge.
